description:
I am a high school student. I am passionate about technology, programming, robotics, and innovation. I consider myself a creative, responsible, and committed individual, with strong teamwork and problem-solving skills.

I am looking for peers who possess initiative, creativity, and a sense of responsibility, along with knowledge of or an interest in programming, technology, and project development. I am seeking individuals who are eager to learn and contribute their own ideas.
summary:
We have developed a mission-based game that brings space mission planning closer to experiences that people can relate to and understand. Through challenges and interactive activities, players take on the roles of those who design and execute a mission, navigating real-world decisions regarding resources, timelines, risks, and objectives.

We address this challenge by transforming the complexity of space mission planning into an active learning experience. The game encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making, while fostering teamwork and engagement. In this way, players gain a practical perspective on the challenges faced by organizations like NASA and discover why every decision matters.

This approach is significant because learning through play boosts motivation and knowledge retention. Furthermore, the project sparks ideas for future solutions and strengthens interest in space exploration initiatives, inspiring new generations to get involved in science and technology.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

This project simulates the management of a base on the Moon or Mars. Each base is inhabited by four astronauts who carry out the essential tasks required for survival. In addition to these operational missions, the project incorporates astronomical events recorded in the DONKI database over the last two years.

What benefits does it have?

The main benefit is that it encourages people who play the game to take an interest in astronomy. There are many brilliant minds across the globe, yet very few show an interest in this field; for this reason, we aim to reach these individuals, sparking their interest so that they might eventually contribute to astronomical endeavors.

What is the intended impact of the project?

The impact we envision for this project is to inspire those who play it to take an interest in astronomy; we aim for the project to reach people all over the world, encouraging them to develop an interest in astronomy.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use to develop your project?

The tools used primarily included HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as programming languages. Additionally, artificial intelligence tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot were employed for code editing and generation; ChatGPT and Gemini were used to generate images for the project and manage translations; and Visual Studio Code served as the code editor for writing and editing the code and DONKI, OSDR and Mars Trek

How is your project creative?

Our project is creative because space-based base-management games—especially those featuring problems that could actually occur—are not currently common.

What factors did your team consider?

The primary factors we took into account were the guidelines sent to all the groups. We also considered the game's design—deciding on the right approach for the project proved challenging—as well as the gameplay, which was the most difficult aspect to determine, until we ultimately settled on a base-management game.
